entries.description: A theme-aware Svelte weather forecast card with current observations, forecast periods, wind, units, and optional atmospheric backgrounds.
representativeQueries: add a weather forecast card to my shadcn-svelte app
show current conditions and the upcoming forecast with wind
display a weather card with an animated rain or snow background

entries.description: A Svelte lunar phase card with illumination, moon age, and estimated next full and new moon dates.
representativeQueries: add a moon phase card to my shadcn-svelte app
show the current lunar phase and illumination
display the next full moon and new moon dates

entries.description: A Svelte tide card with NOAA predictions, a tide chart, station context, and an optional current reading.
representativeQueries: add a tide forecast card to my shadcn-svelte app
show the next high and low tides for a coastal location
display NOAA tide predictions with a chart in feet or meters

entries.description: A composed Svelte dashboard combining weather, moon phase, and tide forecast cards.
representativeQueries: add a weather moon and tide dashboard to my shadcn-svelte app
show weather lunar phase and coastal tide information together
install a complete forecast dashboard with theme-aware cards

entries.description: A JSON weather endpoint for United States coordinates that returns location, current observations, and National Weather Service forecast periods.
representativeQueries: get the weather forecast for latitude 30.2672 longitude -97.7431
retrieve current observations and forecast periods for a US location
fetch a National Weather Service forecast as JSON

entries.description: A JSON tide endpoint that selects the nearest coastal NOAA station and returns predictions, a series, and a current reading when available.
representativeQueries: get tide predictions near latitude 40.5795 longitude -73.8370
find the nearest coastal NOAA tide station for these coordinates
retrieve high and low tide times and water levels as JSON

entries.description: A JSON location search endpoint for US places that returns matching names and coordinates for forecast lookup.
representativeQueries: find the coordinates for Austin Texas
search US places by city and state for a weather lookup
look up a place name and latitude longitude as JSON
